title: Docker multi-service local system
spec: Build a Docker Compose local system with an API, queue-backed worker, PostgreSQL-compatible database, deterministic seed job, health checks, resource limits, and integration tests. Services must use pinned images, bounded worker counts, and named cleanup commands. No external hosted service is allowed.
prompts: Create the multi-service architecture, Compose file, health checks, resource limits, and unit-test foundations.
Implement deterministic seeding of 250,000 jobs and bounded batch processing with idempotency.
Add API pagination, worker retry/dead-letter behavior, and integration tests across all services.
Add migration rollback, interrupted-job recovery, and observability endpoints with regression tests.
Run Compose validation, integration tests, a measured seed-and-drain run, and clean shutdown. Fix failures and write BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md.
